_meta.datasheet_section: Package Types p1 + Table 3-1 p9 + MC package drawing C04-123C p25 + land pattern C04-2123B p26
_meta.package: 8-lead DFN 2x3x0.9 mm (MC), 0.5 mm pitch, EP = pin 9
_meta.notes: D = PWM only, input-to-output bypass. Blank packaging = tube; DT = tape and reel. Same die and package. [height] 1.0 mm max: DS MC package C04-123C: A max 1.00. [temp] DS 1.0 Absolute Maximum Ratings: ambient temp with power applied −40…+85 °C (TJ −40…+125 °C) MCP1640B: PWM only, true output disconnect (DS20002234E features: 'True Load Disconnect Option (MCP1640/B)'); same DFN-8 pinout as the C/D.

pins.name: VFB
pins.note: 1.21 V typ feedback; [enrich] DS abs max: EN, VFB, VIN, VSW, VOUT - GND +6.5 V

pins.name: SGND
pins.note: Connect externally to PGND; [connect] DS Table 3-1/§3.2: SGND, connected externally to PGND

pins.name: PGND
pins.note: Connect externally to SGND; [connect] DS Table 3-1/§3.3: PGND, connected externally to SGND

pins.name: EN
pins.note: High >90 % VIN, low <20 % VIN; [enrich] DS DC char.: EN VIH 90 % of VIN min, VIL 20 % of VIN max; abs max EN - GND +6.5 V

pins.name: SW
pins.note: Inductor from VIN; up to 800 mA peak

pins.name: VOUTP
pins.note: Connect externally to VOUTS; [connect] DS §3.6: in 2x3 DFN VOUTP and VOUTS are connected externally

pins.name: VOUTS
pins.note: Output sense; connect externally to VOUTP; [connect] DS §3.7: in 2x3 DFN VOUTS and VOUTP are connected externally

pins.name: VIN
pins.note: 0.65 V typ / 0.8 V max start-up; >=4.7 uF; [connect] DS §3.8: connect input voltage source to VIN

pins.name: EP
pins.note: No internal connection; must be connected to VSS (same potential as SGND/PGND); [connect] DS Table 3-1/§3.9: EP must be connected to VSS (same potential as SGND/PGND)
